chunks: "Indeed, the lightning strike affects the believer and the disbeliever, but it does not strike one who is engaged in dhikr (remembrance of Allah)."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the speaker of this hadith
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنَ: the believer, one who possesses iman
key_terms.ذَاكِرًا: one engaged in dhikr, remembering Allah

ai.seo_question: Does dhikr protect a person from harm such as lightning?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام teaches that natural events such as lightning may befall both believers and disbelievers. The hadith highlights the special protection and spiritual rank of dhikr, indicating the significance of remembering Allah.
